question.problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14118684/assets/464ba24026d89efb3e62f7807426e5c413f277da3c8087931d2e3fde9a0b8e74.svg)

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system represented by the matrix.
question.worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & -2 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & -8 & -8\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=-\frac{1}{8}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14118684/assets/baf05a693deacc3ef644165bae4de7b1435a90c73f050ac76c48892b2e010393.svg)

and we can apply back substitution. The final equation $y=1$ tells us the value of $y.$ Substituting this value into the first equation, we get

$$
x+2(1)=0 
	\quad\Rightarrow\quad
	x=-2.
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=-2$ and $y=1.$ Or, in vector form, $\left<  -2,1 \right>.$
